name: Ghoul
traits: Cunning undead in the Compass Rose hold. Waits until party fights the zombie on lower deck, then tries to paralyze and drag a victim away.
actions:
Bite. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) piercing damage.

Claws. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) slashing damage. Target must succeed DC 10 Con save or be paralyzed for 1 minute (repeat save end of turn).
notes: Compass Rose C8 lower deck — aft, in the water with a zombie.
